payload.summary: No gate can detect a React Server Component boundary violation: a component with an event handler and no "use client" throws only at request time
payload.detail: Found on the developer-hub branch 2026-08-22. src/components/developer-area/hub/panel-card.tsx shipped rendering <button onClick={ignoreUnavailableActivation}> with no "use client" directive. Because the hub page is a Server Component, React serialised the handler into the flight stream and the route threw "Event handlers cannot be passed to Client Component props" on EVERY render — 17 occurrences on one page load, proven with a dev-server fetch. No gate on the branch could see it: typecheck does not model the RSC boundary; the jsdom DOM tests render the page as an ordinary client tree where onClick is legal; and next build does not catch it either because these routes are Dynamic and are never rendered at build time. Only a live request surfaces it. Corroborating signal that a cheap static rule would work: 12 of the 13 modules importing ignoreUnavailableActivation already carry "use client" on line 1, so a lint rule of the form 'a module importing ignoreUnavailableActivation (or otherwise attaching an on* handler) must carry "use client"' would have caught the one exception at zero runtime cost.
payload.source: Developer hub Phase 1 controller, task 7 review (2026-08-22)
